member.remarks:
Reaching the Light2D on a registered item:
Always works: item.GetComponentsInChildren<Light2D>()
Only when AddLightItem is true: item.GetComponent<LightItem>().light
Only when CUCoreLib created the light itself (see Enabled): item.transform.Find("CustomLight").GetComponent<Light2D>()
Unsafe, template dependent: item.transform.GetChild(0).GetComponent<Light2D>()
